title: Don_t_Timing
slide_intent: Recognize unsuitable timing because speed can distract from the content even when the graphic is correct.
strategic_value: The rejected timing example can help DB teams diagnose a motion problem that a still frame conceals.
demonstration: The same train interior and white DB logo use a different reveal cadence; a cyan diagonal line marks the sequence as rejected.
practical_value: Compare the temporal behavior with DBV41 rather than treating the shared final logo as sufficient approval.
